other_mods.description: Adds a hotkey that allows the player to quickly dismantle player-built walls.
Install this to enable the in-game menu and shared settings for this mod.
Adds an in-game above the squad UI so you can quickly remove queued jobs for one member, selected members, a whole squad, or all player squads.
Adds an Execute action for downed enemies in the right-click context flow.
Highlights downed characters with state text/icons and shows configurable bounty symbol markers for downed and live bounty targets while ALT is held.
Adds a search bar to Kenshi trader windows so you can find items faster.
Adds persistent custom markers to Kenshi's world map through RE_Kenshi. You can place markers per save, assign a type, add a short label, and manage them directly on the map.
Adds a search bar to Kenshi crafting and research windows so you can filter visible recipes and blueprints without scrolling through the full list.
Adds small configurable status markers to squad portraits so you can read critical downed and injury states at a glance without opening each character panel.
Adds an in-game panel to the Options menu that shows the player's hidden faction relations.
Adds an in-game debug toolkit for Kenshi that brings Health, Stats, Teleport, Inventory, and Spawn tools together in a single panel, with spawn faction testing.
Adds search bars to Kenshi's inventory UI so you can filter the active player inventory view or supported creature and pack-animal inventory views without moving items.
